How it all gets built

Phone in, signed APK out.

1PromptApp Hub’s Prompt Maker bundles the project, stack and last build error.
2ZipClaude sends back a versioned zip. Version and zip name bump every time.
3DeployApp Hub diffs it against GitHub and pushes only the changed files.
4InstallGitHub Actions builds and signs it. One tap and it’s on my phone.
